label: Small-employer insurance subsidy: monthly pay ceiling
unit: KRW average monthly remuneration, below which support is available
appliesTo: Employers with fewer than 10 employees, on newly enrolled employees
why: The support most often missed on a first hire, and the threshold that decides whether a candidate is inside it at all. It is also not a headcount rule despite being described as one: pay level, newness of enrolment, the support period and the employee's own property and income all gate it. Budgeting the subsidy in before approval is the mistake it invites.

history.source: Ministry of Employment and Labor / National Pension Service — Duru-nuri social insurance support
history.note: For businesses with fewer than 10 employees, supporting 80% of the national pension and employment insurance contributions of both employer and employee for up to 36 months, on employees newly enrolled — generally meaning no national pension or employment insurance record in the preceding year. Support for those earning ₩2,300,000 or more is calculated on a ₩2,300,000 base. Employees whose prior-year property tax base reaches ₩600,000,000, or whose global income reaches ₩43,000,000, are excluded.
